爱莎贝儿-157CM-L 粉肤 AHRC033 白井 美野Shirai Mino-陷入爱情的碎碎念
【你的关怀你的视线，只注意到我的感觉真好。
靠近我吧，现在走入我的心。
你朝我走来了，我好紧张，现在的你也在动摇吧，我看到了你那透着微红的耳垂。
请狂热的拥抱我吧，不要再有逃避的念头。
我希望我们能更加的甜蜜，只有我们两个人，求求你，快点答应我的要求吧。】
胸型：157CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-157CM-L Pink AHRC033 Shirai Mino-Random Thoughts of Falling in Love
【It feels so good to only notice me, your care and your gaze.
Come closer to me, enter my heart now.
You're coming towards me, I'm so nervous, you're wavering too, I see your slightly red earlobes.
Please embrace me passionately, don't have any more thoughts of running away.
I hope we can be even sweeter, just the two of us, please, please grant my request quickly.】
Body type: 157CM-L with Pink skin tone.
